Otherwise set it to NONE. material_relevance=true requires a matched requested family, but a source-family match alone does not make an irrelevant candidate material. A blog, portal repost, or third-party retelling never satisfies an issuer- or customer-official request merely because it discusses the requested company or product. A landing page, redirect page, or document referenced by an already fetched page may be materially relevant as a route to the full original source; do not reject it merely because it is not yet evidence.
